findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Observed a container of frappe mix being stored inside the ice machine with the container touching the ice used for drinks. CORRECTED: PIC was notified and the mix was moved to the cooler. Ensure that food - in this case the ice that goes into drinks - is protected from cross contamination by keeping it separate from other food items and food packaging. Ice used for drinks should not be used for cold holding other food items.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(4) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (4) Except as specified under Subparagraph 3-501.15(B)(2) and in (B) of this section, storing the food in packages, covered containers, or wrappings.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Observed ice in basin of hand sink. PIC was informed that drinks and ice should be dumped in the triple sink rather than the hand sink to avoid cross-contamination. Ensure staff understand that the hand sink may no be used for any purpose aside from hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Observed the sanitizer in use on the truck to measure less than 50ppm chlorine. PIC was informed that sanitizer solution was too low, and sanitizer was remade, measuring 100ppm chlorine. Ensure staff monitor the concentration of the sanitizer frequently and replace as needed.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A).

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
An employee was observed washing hands in the triple sink used for dish washing. Discussed with PIC that hands should only be washed in hand washing sinks. Be sure to educate employees on proper handwashing techniques and the use of designated handwashing sinks. 

2-301.15: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands in a HANDWASHING SINK only.
